item.title: Award-Winning Producer-Artist Ziv Joins NYMA Talent Management
item.description: Producer-artist Ziv, known for his work with Ben&Ben, joins NYMA Talent Management as he continues bridging Asian pop and global music.

item.title: OFW trust in government depends on leadership performance, study finds
item.description: A study by The Fourth Wall finds OFW trust in government depends more on credible leadership and crisis response than institutions alone.

item.title: Buenas PH partners with ‘Pinoy Pawnstars’ Boss Toyo for community impact through CSR arm, Buenas Cares
item.description: Popular Filipino content creator Boss Toyo has been named the lead ambassador for Buenas Cares, the official charitable arm of PAGCOR-regulated gaming platform Buenas PH.

item.title: SHDA Golf Cup 2026 Swings Into Its 4th Edition with Sportsmanship and Collaboration Driving Developments Forward
item.description: Entering its fourth year, the SHDA Golf Cup has evolved into more than a tournament. It has become an annual gathering where leaders from across the housing ecosystem come together to exchange insights on emerging industry developments and strengthen relationships that support the housing sector's continued growth.

item.title: Bloomberry’s megaFUNalo! launches first-ever 100% transparent Live Studio Games to expand live entertainment footprint
item.description: PAGCOR-licensed online gaming platform megaFUNalo! is redefining the Philippine iGaming landscape by launching the country’s first 100% transparent live studio games. Featuring an industry-first complete glass table and a floor-to-ceiling LED backdrop, the move addresses a global surge in player demand for authentic, verifiable, and immersive gaming experiences.

item.title: Spider Man Brand New Day Drops First Official Trailer, Hits PH Cinemas July 29
item.description: Tom Holland returns as Spider Man in his fourth installment with Spider Man Brand New Day, out in PH cinemas July 29.

item.title: Do More of What You Love with Samsung Home Appliances
item.description: Samsung eases the load of daily routines to help you spend more time on what matters most.

item.title: The Real Story That Inspired the Upcoming Horror Comedy They Will Kill You
item.description: Fun, bloody, and a little unhinged. That is the kind of energy They Will Kill You brings to cinemas on March 25, and it is exactly what makes it such an easy, entertaining watch.

item.title: The Role of Women in Shaping the Future of the BPO Industry
item.description: With women comprising 54% of its workforce and half of leadership, TELUS Digital Philippines is shaping an inclusive future of work in the digital economy.

item.title: H.E.R. and Liza Soberano Star in DreamWorks’ First Filipino-Inspired Animated Film, Forgotten Island
item.description: H.E.R. and Liza Soberano star in DreamWorks’ Forgotten Island, the studio’s first Filipino-inspired animated film about friendship, folklore, and growing up.
